title: Stuntcar Extreme
statusNote: Plays. The card installer accepts this plain Series 60 application as it is (system/apps/SCE with SCE.aif and SCE.app). It asks for a player name, then shows the main menu; a Quick Race (Ring of Fire) and a Championship race (Metropolitan) both load and run in 3D with steering, acceleration, the view change and pause.
notes: The first start asks for a player name on a letter grid: pick letters with the left soft key, 5 or OK, then choose the return arrow in the bottom right corner to finish.
The Help lists race keys for three phones; the Nokia N-Gage ones are the ones that apply here.

Multiplayer is a head-to-head race over Bluetooth, between two players in one room of the site (Menu > Multiplayer). One chooses Host Game. The other chooses Search for Hosts, which puts the host's name beside Join, then Join. Both then pick a car, the host picks the track, and the race begins when both have chosen Start Race.

multiplayer.menu: Multiplayer > Host Game / Search for Hosts, then Join
multiplayer.statusNote: Two players in one room: one chooses Host Game, the other Search for Hosts and then Join. Both get the lobby, where the track the host picks shows on the other screen, and both choose Start Race. A race on The Metropolitan ran on both screens; the joiner saw the host's car ahead and saw it drive off. When one ends the race both return to the lobby; when one leaves it the host says Connection Lost.

controls.source: The game's Help (General Controls and Race Controls for Nokia N-Gage). Steering, accelerate, view change and pause were also tried in a race; that 5 and OK select in menus was observed.

actions.left: Steer left; change a menu value
actions.right: Steer right; change a menu value
actions.rsk: Change view; cancel or back in menus (Quit on the main menu)

notes: Racing layout: steer on the arrows, accelerate on X or Space, brake on Z, nitro on C or left Shift. On a gamepad A or the right trigger accelerates, X or the left trigger brakes, B is nitro, Y changes the view and Start pauses.
